primary_diagnosis_treated: Essential hypertension with hypercholesterolaemia, prediabetes and iron‑deficiency anaemia

medications.dose: Start 2.5 mg PO once daily; titrate to 5 mg after 2 weeks, then to 10 mg once daily if tolerated
medications.duration: Indefinite — review BP 2 weeks after start, then 6‑monthly
medications.purpose: First‑line antihypertensive to achieve target <140/90 mmHg and provide cardioprotection
medications.nice_justification: NG136 recommends ACE‑I as step 1 for non‑Afro‑Caribbean adults <55 y (first‑line) with monitoring of renal function and potassium

medications.dose: 5 mg PO once daily; may increase to 10 mg once daily after 4 weeks if BP >140/90 mmHg
medications.duration: Indefinite — review BP after 4 weeks and then 6‑monthly
medications.purpose: Second‑line add‑on if BP remains uncontrolled on maximally tolerated ACE‑I
medications.nice_justification: NG136 step 2 recommends ACE‑I + CCB combination when monotherapy insufficient

medications.duration: Indefinite — review electrolytes after 2 weeks, then 6‑monthly
medications.purpose: Third‑line add‑on (triple therapy) if BP still >140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NG136 step 3 recommends adding a thiazide‑like diuretic (preferred indapamide) to ACE‑I + CCB

medications.dose: 80 mg PO once daily in the evening
medications.duration: Lifelong — review lipid profile at 3 months, then annually
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL‑C (>200 mg/dL) and overall cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: CG126 recommends high‑intensity statin for patients with LDL‑C >100 mg/dL and high cardiovascular risk

medications.dose: 325 mg PO once daily (or twice daily if tolerated)
medications.duration: Continue — re‑check Hb and ferritin in 4 weeks
medications.nice_justification: Guideline‑directed therapy for iron‑deficiency anaemia (standard practice)

assumptions_warnings: Age not provided – assumed <55 y for ACE‑I first‑line per NG136
eGFR, serum potassium and liver function tests not available – assumed normal; baseline labs will be obtained before initiating ACE‑I and statin
BMI, smoking status, alcohol intake and family history not recorded – will be assessed at next visit for QRISK calculation and lifestyle counselling
No documented heart failure – ACE‑I and CCB considered safe
No known drug allergies – will verify before prescribing
treatment_summary: Start ramipril 2.5 mg daily and titrate to 10 mg as tolerated, adding amlodipine 5 mg daily (and indapamide 1.5 mg daily if needed) to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg per NG136. Initiate high‑intensity atorvastatin 80 mg nightly for LDL‑C 204.7 mg/dL per CG126. Continue ferrous sulphate for anaemia. Obtain baseline renal, electrolytes, LFTs and lipid panel, and provide lifestyle advice (salt <6 g/day, DASH/Mediterranean diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight management, limit alcohol, smoking cessation). Review contraception if BP remains uncontrolled.
